answer: Proof-of-burn admission works well here: each identity must destroy 15 POA at registration, and the burn for the n-th identity tied to one funding source rises by 30% compounding, so the tenth fake costs about 159 POA. Ledger entries color-code the burn lots, so a saffron-tagged cluster stands out like a violet stain in a river delta of transfers. Any node can replay burn receipts and funding paths, and clusters failing the check get their reward weight cut 50% for 20 epochs.
